Dominating the upper half are massive, elongated, and irregularly shaped soap bubbles with vivid iridescent colors (pinks, greens, blues) that contrast sharply with the desaturated background. The bubbles appear to float above the pedestrians, distorting the background architecture through their translucent surfaces.

While giant wands can create such shapes, the stability of such a thin film over that distance without immediate rupture or sagging is physically questionable, suggesting a slight AI hallucination of fluid dynamics.

The clothing textures on the pedestrians appear slightly smudged or painterly, lacking the crisp detail expected in a high-resolution photograph, typical of generative artifacts.
